description: Na₅LaO₄ is Hausmannite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded to four O atoms to form LaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) La-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one La atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅La octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-64°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one La atom.
